summary: Executed iteration53 preview/local verification for read-recovery controls, analytics-read-plan authorization/validation/sanitization, auth/CORS guardrails, and My Products retry UX behavior. Tests were run only against preview URL + local loopback Mongo; no production access was performed.
action_items: Run the remaining heavy mandatory suites from review_request section B/C/D/F (large disposable UUID fixture + historical parity/regression packs) to complete full acceptance coverage.
Keep production status unchanged: preview/local proof does NOT equal live production1970e575 recovery verification.
Optional code-policy cleanup: frontend src/lib/api.js currently falls back to window.origin when env origin differs; this conflicts with strict env-only URL policy and should be reviewed.
critical_code_review_comments: read_plan_policy + release_database guard behavior matched tested contracts: only fixed pipeline selector accepted, forbidden stage patterns rejected, and general explain via command() remained default-deny without permit.
Sanitization boundary held in tested responses: no ObjectId leakage and no raw query/filter/rejected plan internals in /api/admin/analytics-read-plan output.

Auth protections verified in this run: registration default disabled, httpOnly cookie on login, bcrypt $2b$ hash prefix, page-level permission gates, logout revocation, CORS explicit-origin behavior, and brute-force lockout reached 429 after repeated failures.
Frontend retry behavior validated with MOCKED 503 injections: one 503 -> auto single retry recovery; two 503 -> exactly two requests then error; manual retry started a new bounded pair and recovered.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest tests passed across two suites)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Only read-only preview API checks and local policy/guard checks were executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Artifacts produced: iteration_53_read_recovery.xml, iteration_53_auth_live.xml, and browser automation evidence under /app/test_reports/ui_iteration53*, plus raw console logs under /root/.emergent/automation_output/20261010_111347, 20261010_111448, 20261010_111526. rca of the issue: No blocking defect reproduced in executed scope. One intermediate UI script expectation was incorrect (assumed manual retry would always produce two additional requests even when next request is successful); corrected by enforcing a deterministic 503/503/503/success sequence, which confirmed bounded retry behavior works as designed. Production limitation remains explicit: this is controlled preview/local evidence only, not authorized live recovery verification.
